Akvayasūri
also Akṣayaśāstrin; of the Mokṣaguṇḍa family; son of Veṅkaṭārya, the [Page009-a. brother of Pakṣadhara Yallayārya; guru of Umāmaheśvara of the Vellāla family, otherwise known a. Abhinavakālidāsa (Bhāgavatacampū,

etc.).
--Bhāgavatacampūvyāº.--Ratnāvalī, a C. on his pupil Umāmaheśvara's Bhāgavatacampū. Adyar II. p. 20b.

. Śṛṅgerī Mutt 315. Tirupati 320.
